## Project Details

### FraudShield
Ecommerce fraud detection system that monitors transactions against configurable rules and returns a risk score with specific reasons for each flag, plus an analytics dashboard for reviewing flagged activity. Built to replace manual fraud review with explainable, rule-based scoring. Stack: Python, Flask, MongoDB. Status: completed, public.

### Bot Ecosystem
A collection of Telegram and Discord bots handling automation, giveaways, moderation, and games, running across thousands of users on both platforms. Covers custom commands, auto-moderation, and community workflow automation. Stack: Python, Telebot, Discord.py. Status: active, public.

### ClickSync
A two-way bridge between ClickUp and Google Sheets built on Google Apps Script and the ClickUp API. Change a task in either tool and both stay in sync, which eliminates duplicate data entry for teams. Runs entirely on Apps Script with no server or hosting. Stack: Apps Script, Google Sheets, ClickUp API, JavaScript. Status: active, private.

### SEO Overview Dashboard
A unified dashboard that pulls live data from Google Search Console and GA4, calculates which projects and pages need attention, flags pages that are dropping, and surfaces a prioritised work log. Replaces manual weekly SEO checks with a single screen. Stack: Python, GSC API, GA4 API, Flask. Status: active, private.

### Email to Slack Notifier
Watches a Gmail inbox and forwards matching emails into a Slack channel, filtering by sender, subject, or keyword before posting. Runs entirely on Google Apps Script with no server, hosting, or cost. Stack: Apps Script, Gmail API, Slack Webhook, JavaScript. Status: completed, private.

### API / Scraping Suite
A private collection of 25+ tools covering API automation, scraping pipelines, session management, and platform-specific workflow automation. Deployed as needed and run quietly in the background. Stack: Python, Requests, Selenium. Status: active, private.

### CMS Platform
A static but full-featured CMS that is entirely JSON-based, allowing content updates without touching the codebase. No longer maintained. Stack: HTML, CSS, JavaScript, JSON. Status: completed, public.

### Gamified Learning Progress Tracker
A full-stack learning progress tracker with gamification: automatic badges, user profiles, and progress charts. First major full-stack project. Stack: PHP, MySQL, HTML, CSS, JavaScript. Status: completed, public.
